Explore the journey of ESA’s Mercury mission 14393 views 191 likes ESA / Science & Exploration / Space Science / BepiColombo It’s not easy getting to Mercury. At its closest, the innermost planet of the Solar System might be only 77 million km away from Earth. It will, however, require more energy for the European-Japanese spacecraft BepiColombo to get to its destination than it would reaching the dwarf planet Pluto, orbiting between 4.4 and 7.3 billion km away from the Sun.
